name: Ihlaselo lentliziyo
tagline: Intlungu yesifuba engadluliyo — tsalela umnxeba ngoku.

urgent.heading: Ingxamisekile — tsalela umnxeba ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Biza i-ambulensi ngoko nangoko. Hlafuna i-aspirin enye ukuba ikhona. Musa ukuziqhubela.
red_flags: Intlungu, uxinzelelo, ukuqinana okanye ukucinezeleka esifubeni — okuhlala ngaphezu kwemizuzu embalwa
Intlungu esasazeka engalweni (rhoqo ekhohlo), emhlathini, entanyeni, emqolo okanye esiswini
Ukuphelelwa ngumoya ngesiquphe, nokuba kukho okanye akukho ntlungu yesifuba
Ubuthathaka obukhulu ngesiquphe, isiyezi okanye ukuwa isiqaqa
Kwabasetyhini: ukudinwa okungaqhelekanga, intlungu efana nokungagayeki kakuhle, okanye intlungu yomqolo

what_is_it.heading: Ihlaselo lentliziyo ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Ihlaselo lentliziyo lenzeka xa ukuhamba kwegazi kwinxalenye yesihlunu sentliziyo kuvaleka ngesiquphe. Isihlunu siqala ukufa ngemizuzu.
paragraphs: Uninzi lwehlaselo lentliziyo lubangelwa lihlwili elibumba phezu kweplakhi enamafutha ngaphakathi komthambo wentliziyo. Ukuvaleka kuthintela ioksijini ukuba ifike kwisihlunu sentliziyo. Okukhona umthambo uhlala uvaliwe, kokukhona kusifa isihlunu esininzi.

Unyango lwangoku esibhedlele lunokuvula umthambo ovaliweyo lusindise enye inxalenye yentliziyo — kodwa kuphela ukuba ufika ngokukhawuleza. Umzuzu ngamnye wokulibazisa uthetha umonakalo osisigxina ngakumbi.

items.headline: Ixesha = isihlunu
items.body: Umzuzu ngamnye womthambo ovaliweyo uthetha isihlunu sentliziyo esilahlekayo. Unyango kwiiyure zokuqala lunokusindisa uninzi lwaso.

items.headline: Umbulali ophambili
items.body: Izifo zentliziyo nemithambo yegazi zezona zikhokelela ekufeni okubangelwa zizifo ezingosuleliyo eMzantsi Afrika.

items.headline: Azisoloko zifana kwabasetyhini
items.body: Abasetyhini basenokungabi nentlungu yesifuba eqhelekileyo — endaweni yoko babe nokudinwa, intlungu yomhlathi, isicaphucaphu okanye ukuphelelwa ngumoya. Ezi mpawu kulula ukuzijongela phantsi.

items.headline: Kunokuthintelwa kakhulu
items.body: Ukutshaya, uxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu, isifo seswekile, i-cholesterol ephezulu, ukungasebenzi komzimba nokutyeba ziqhuba uninzi lohlaselo lwentliziyo. Zonke zinokulawulwa.

pull_quote.text: Uninzi lwabantu abasweleka ngenxa yohlaselo lwentliziyo basweleka bengakafiki esibhedlele — ngokuqhelekileyo kuba belindile, benethemba lokuba kuza kudlula. Ukuba awuqinisekanga, tsalela umnxeba.

signs.heading: Into onokuyiva
signs.lede: Iimpawu zohlaselo lwentliziyo azisoloko zibonakala ngendlela enkulu. Iimpawu ezithambileyo kodwa ezingapheliyo zisafuna ingqwalasela engxamisekileyo.

items.title: Intlungu okanye uxinzelelo esifubeni
items.description: Uvakalelo olunzima, olucinezelayo, oluqinayo okanye olutshisayo embindini wesifuba. Luhlala ngaphezu kwemizuzu embalwa, okanye luye lubuye.

items.title: Intlungu esasazeka ngaphandle
items.description: Intlungu okanye ukungabikho kwemvakalelo engalweni (rhoqo ekhohlo), emhlathini, entanyeni, emqolo okanye phezulu esiswini. Inokwenzeka ngaphandle kwentlungu yesifuba.

items.title: Ukuphelelwa ngumoya
items.description: Ubunzima bokuphefumla ngesiquphe, ngamanye amaxesha lolona phawu lodwa. Kuxhaphake ngakumbi kwabasetyhini, abantu abadala, nakubantu abanesifo seswekile.

items.title: Ukubila, isicaphucaphu, isiyezi
items.description: Ukubila okubandayo nokuncamathelayo, isicaphucaphu okanye ukugabha, ubuthathaka ngesiquphe okanye ukuwa isiqaqa. Kudla ngokuhamba neempawu ezingentla.

items.myth: Ihlaselo lentliziyo lihlala lithetha intlungu enkulu yesifuba.
items.fact: Uhlaselo oluninzi lwentliziyo luqala ngokungonwabi okuncinci luze lukhule kancinci. Abasetyhini, abantu abadala nabantu abanesifo seswekile badla ngokuba neempawu ezingaqhelekanga.

items.myth: Ukuba ndimncinci kwaye ndomelele, andinakuhlaselwa yintliziyo.
items.fact: Uhlaselo lwentliziyo kubantu abatsha baseMzantsi Afrika luyanda — luqhutywa kukutshaya, i-vaping, ukusetyenziswa kweziyobisi, imbali yosapho neengxaki ze-cholesterol ezingafunyaniswanga.
Intlungu efana ne-heartburn ehlala ixesha elide, ebuyayo, ehamba nokubila okanye ukuphelelwa ngumoya, okanye evakala yahlukile kwesiqhelo — kufuneka ihlolwe.

items.myth: Ndiza kulinda iyure ndibone ukuba iyadlula.
items.fact: Ukulinda sesona sizathu sikhulu sokuba abantu basweleke ngenxa yohlaselo lwentliziyo. Ukuba awuqinisekanga ngaphezu kwemizuzu eli-10 — biza i-ambulensi.

action_steps.heading: Yintoni omawuyenze — umzuzu okrokrela uhlaselo lwentliziyo

items.title: Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 okanye ku-112 ngoko nangoko
items.description: Yithi 'ndikrokrela uhlaselo lwentliziyo'. Abeparamedic baqala unyango kwi-ambulensi baze bakuse kwisibhedlele esikwaziyo ukunyanga iingxaki zentliziyo.

items.title: Hlafuna i-aspirin eqhelekileyo enye (300 mg) ukuba ikhona
items.description: Ukuhlafuna — hayi ukuyiginya iphelele — kungenisa i-aspirin egazini ngokukhawuleza. Musa ukuyithatha ukuba uyayaliwa, usebenzisa amayeza anciphisa ukujiya kwegazi, okanye usandula ukopha.

items.title: Hlala phantsi uphumle. Khulula iimpahla eziqinileyo
items.description: Hlala kakuhle. Musa ukulala tyaba ukuba ukuphefumla kunzima. Zama ukuzola — uloyiko lwandisa umthwalo entliziyweni.

items.title: Musa ukuziqhubela
items.description: Ukuba uyawa isiqaqa uqhuba, ungafa kwaye wenzakalise nabanye. Linda i-ambulensi — abeparamedic baphethe izixhobo zokusindisa ubomi.

items.title: Vula ucango ukuze abeparamedic bangene
items.description: Qinisekisa ukuba banokufika kuwe ngokukhawuleza. Ukuba uwedwa, yiya kwindawo apho umntu anokukufumana khona.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawumfowunele ngoku
get_help.lede: Uhlaselo lwentliziyo olukrokrelwayo yimeko engxamisekileyo. Musa ukulinda, musa ukuqhuba, musa 'ukubona ukuba kuza kuhamba njani'.

helplines.name: Uncedo olungxamisekileyo (iselula)
helplines.description: Ifikelela kuyo nayiphi na inkonzo yongxamiseko xa utsalela umnxeba ngeselula
